title: Balancer General Settings
summary:
Administrators can learn how to manage settings at the engagement and legal entity levels in General Settings. These settings include:
- Engagement currency
- Certification process controls
- Bulk approve action
- Variance thresholds
- Cross entity groups
- Standard user page access
- User role transfer
- Auditor permissions
- Enabling cross entity group accounts
- Period opening/closing restrictions
- Custom import setup.
